answer: Sybil farms mint cheap identities to scoop attest and grade rewards. Our counter is a pigment bond in a lagoon of escrow: a new agent locks 8400 POA for 21 epochs under a unique shade hash, then waits a 72-hour forge delay before gaining weight. Cloning 200 sockpuppets would immobilize 1680000 POA for weeks. Peers verify the lock tx, shade commitment, and forge-delay timestamp; a mismatch drops weight to zero. If attestations contradict the panel median on over 35% of items, 60% of the pigment bond is slashed to honest jurors, the rest stays locked 12 more epochs, and grade seats are revoked.
